note: renv restores the locked numerical environment; it is not a runtime dependency of the package. Pinning its version fixes which renv is used; recording its SHA-256 here is what makes retrieving that exact file verifiable. Set sha256 from a download you have checked (scripts/restore_validation.R prints the digest of whatever it fetched), and CI caches the verified file so a later restore does not depend on the archive being reachable.
